detail.longDescription:
arXivisual is an AI tool that won TartanHacks '26 (Carnegie Mellon). It turns arXiv papers into interactive visual stories with 3Blue1Brown-style animated explanations, using Claude for agents, ElevenLabs for voice, and Manim for animation.  

Tool:
https://www.arxivisual.org

One I created a little while ago for "From PDF to Evidence: Structure-Aware Retrieval for Clinical Practice Guidelines":
https://www.arxivisual.org/abs/2609.33447
